channel.title: U.S. District Court, District of Maine — Opinions (govinfo)
channel.description: Official GPO govinfo USCOURTS feed of new/updated D. Maine opinions with authenticated GPO PDFs. Feed URL taken from GPO's own published feed directory (github.com/usgpo/rss). Complements fed-dme-opinions (CourtListener) with an official redundant path; some overlap between the two is expected. GPO notes feed notifications may pause during bulk reprocessing.
